text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember her, everyone? Do
you
remember the Umamusume named

Matikanefukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
She was a greedy little girl with no
talent of her
own who trusted only in
luck to win the day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
However, that girl still took the Arima
Kinen. In
exchange, she gave up
everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But now she has become a god. Having 
transcended Umahood to reach the
divine realm,
her pearlescent glow shines
down upon—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! I'm still me! I'm still alive,
and
kicking
harder than ever!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My great health record is my best
feature, so don't write me off just yet!
May your happiness flourish like a flower
in full bloom—and peace reign in the
Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Trainer! Are you happy? Was
training me
worth it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sniff! That's all I wanted to hear! All right! Now I just need to take this energy to the winner's interview!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, everyone. I'm afraid I've gone
and
made this joyous occasion even
more exuberant!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
After blessing the chrysanthemum stage,
fortune
has now smiled upon Nakayama
as well!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fortune smiles on those who wish for it,
and
happiness comes to those who seek
it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With that, I wish you all a happy New
Year! It will be my extreme pleasure to
bring good cheer to
all of you again
next year!
